name: Kwality Wall's Cornetto - Butterscotch
ingredients_raw: Water, Wafer Biscuit Cone (17.6%) (Refined Wheat Flour(Maida), Sugar, Palm Oil, Emulsifier - E322, Iodised Salt, Food Colour - E150d), Compound Coating (16.4%) (Sugar, Interesterified Vegetable Oil, Palm oil, Coconut Oil, Cocoa Solids, Milk Solids, Emulsifier - E322, Artificial (Vanillin & Butterscotch) Flavouring Substances, Sesame oil, Vitamin A), Sugar, Milk Solids, Palm Oil, Butterscotch Confectionery (3.8%)(Sugar, Nuts - Cashew, Dairy Butter), Liquid Glucose, Emulsifier - E471, Vegetable Protein (Soy), Stabilisers (E412, E417, E407, E410), Nature Identical & Artificial (Butterscotch) Flavouring Substances, Food Colour - E102.Contains Milk, Soy, Wheat & Nuts.
